source.publisher: geoBoundaries / William & Mary geoLab; original OpenStreetMap, Lee Beryman / Wambacher
source.recordDifference: Published GeoJSON omits Bayuquan District, Lanzhou New Area and Qingshuihe County from the source archive; source names Zhijiang City and Jiangshan City have leading whitespace normalized. No missing feature is fabricated.
source.stableIdPolicy: Preserve published shapeID and fixed revision. Original archive has NAME/Level/Shape_Leng/Shape_Area only, no OSM relation ID, official administrative code or parent code. shapeID is explicitly a distributor identifier.
source.temporalLimitation: The original metadata claims 2017, but original shapefile XML records append/dissolve processing in August 2021. The fixed file is mixed or uncertified vintage. It is used as an experimental county geometry reference for the 2020-01-01 game scenario, not certified 2020 or untouched 2017 administrative truth. No unverified change is backdated.

license.conditions: Retain notices and attribution; include ODbL URI; distribute publicly used derivative database under ODbL and offer machine-readable derivative data or alterations. Local internal use is allowed. This does not license program code.

source.adoptionReason: Actual whole-country county polygons, clear source-archive ODbL license and fixed revision; actual current partition has better validity/overlap/coverage than the available 2020-published historical OSM edition. County polygons are used rather than relabelled provinces or synthetic nationwide subdivision. Large western counties and tiny city districts remain granularity risks to check against unchanged gameplay limits.

alternatives.name: Official NGCC 2019 DLG
alternatives.observed: Official announcement dated 2019-07-23; 1:50,000 data current to 2018; 1:250,000 and 1:1,000,000 current to 2017; CGCS2000. Provided/used under surveying-results management provisions; free for government decision, national defence and public services.
alternatives.reason: No confirmed general redistribution grant or directly acquired redistributable county polygon snapshot; public availability is not a redistribution license.

alternatives.name: National Bureau of Statistics hierarchy/2019 and 2020 statistical codes
alternatives.observed: Official reply identifies 2020 statistical codes as of 2020-06-30 and based on county-and-above administrative codes. Official coding rules distinguish province, prefecture, county and lower statistical units.
alternatives.reason: A hierarchy/code table is not a polygon source; post-January-2020 table cannot silently certify January boundaries. No code-to-English-distributor-ID crosswalk was fabricated.

alternatives.name: geoBoundaries 3.0.0 CHN ADM3/ADM2/ADM1
alternatives.reason: Publication in May 2020 does not mean January-2020 boundaries. Actual historical ADM3 has material overlap and larger omissions versus active CHN territory, measured in historical-source-metrics.json. Historical ADM1 is the compatible original OSM/Wambacher 2017 source family; only exact whole containment or individually bounded machine-scale remnants support parents.

alternatives.name: geoBoundaries fixed current CHN ADM2
alternatives.reason: Older 2,391 county features versus ADM3 2,864. Metadata PDDL proof references a 2014 prefecture/province post, while actual county source points to a different 2017 post; licensing provenance and missing detail are weaker.

alternatives.name: geoBoundaries current CHN ADM1
alternatives.reason: 2019 Wikimedia-derived boundaries differ from OSM county original source and include Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macao; cannot infer official parents by largest overlap or enlarge CHN ownership.

alternatives.name: OCHA HDX China COD-AB 2020
alternatives.reason: Primary dataset access returned HTTP 403 during research. Metadata-only summaries indicate coarse ADM2 prefecture-scale units, not the county precision sought; actual source file not acquired, so no polygon/ID/license claim is made from the inaccessible file.

implementation.scopePolicy: Clip only to currently active CHN game territory, preserve all non-CHN territory and existing KOR/PRK fine IDs/geometry/admin lineage. Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan and disputed source areas are not acquired because a source labels them CHN.
implementation.method: Replace only active CHN cells. Preserve all other IDs, records, macro and seed lineage. GEOS common offline source/residual/baseline-neighbor partition; boundaries and adjacency from these exact fills. Source-free gameplay gains are separately contact-ledgered, not administrative facts.

hierarchy.policy: Only same-original-source whole polygon containment is used. Unknown parents retain the existing supported country-envelope-residual contract. Native shapeID is a distributor ID, not an official code. Source hierarchy is experimental and does not certify 2020 legal boundaries.

countrySummary.sourceVintage: Metadata 2017 with source processing in 2021; not certified exact 2020

scale.vertexDefinition: Polygon coordinate count includes each stored closed ring and repeats shared nodes across cells. Edge coordinate count includes stored polyline endpoints. Country incident edge counts include internal edges once and shared national edges once for each incident country. These are actual delivered representation counts, not invented unique mesh node totals.

existingGames.limitation: Original-catalog pools and validated lossless private checkpoints are retained. Late old-catalog assets and ongoing commands are not promised under the new active catalog. Existing IDs are never silently interpreted as new catalog IDs.

residuals.policy: Source polygons and source IDs remain source facts; contact-ledger residual additions are explicit game geometry. Source-plus-ledger physical equations and the shared-partition degree² certificates are authoritative. Raw floating overlay differences remain visible in the independent proof.

classification.coastalApproximation: Two coastal remainder pieces extend beyond the unchanged 10 km original-contact bound. Some inner land remains due to conservative 1 km contact sampling and an inscribed 32-sided distance boundary. Residual-strip-free coverage is not claimed.

environment.axisOrder: GeoJSON longitude,latitude; no coordinate transformation in verification
environment.areaBasis: GEOS planar degrees squared for exact coverage; WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic km² for size reporting

deliveredFiniteSegments.method: Supplemental strict per-coordinate finite-segment and cyclic coverage recheck of the same actual hashed delivery; original full PBF fill/edge validation remains independent evidence.

renderedDelivery.method: Actual hashed candidate PBF decoding at zooms 0–6. Separate CHN/KOR/PRK scanline fill coverage against the immutable predecessor union, 8-unit row sampling and unchanged 1.5-unit quantization coast bound. Edge vertices and segment midpoints checked against both incident decoded fill boundaries; per-coordinate subpixel exceptions recorded. Exact detail mesh segments, symmetric adjacency, ID-mapped non-target geometry and administrative/seed parent semantics independently checked.

knownLimits.detail: The original metadata claims 2017, but original shapefile XML records append/dissolve processing in August 2021. The fixed file is mixed or uncertified vintage. It is used as an experimental county geometry reference for the 2020-01-01 game scenario, not certified 2020 or untouched 2017 administrative truth. No unverified change is backdated.
These source fine families retain explicit supported fallback macro membership; no centroid/name/largest-overlap guess is presented as an official parent.
Natural county units remain intact. Very large western counties may exceed the unchanged local frontier caps; no arbitrary subdivision or cap relaxation is claimed.
Classified source-free baseline components remain explicitly represented; see the residual ledger and its locations.

Raw WGS84 Geod areas of differently subdivided source unions, residuals and envelopes are diagnostic and can be non-additive because a new geodesic segment set is implied. They are not an exact additive national territory ledger. Shared-partition planar/exact degree² coverage and ledger certificates establish missing/extra/overlap; geodesic areas of actual shared cells report size.

Explicit full CHN detail selection still loads the full immutable country geometry. Small changed-cell turns use bounded exact shards; their actual timing is measured separately. Viewport-only explicit selection is not implemented.

Lossless original-catalog snapshots/history and live pool objects are preserved, with validated readback and undo/redo recovery preview. Automatic process-restart session rehydration and full continued old-version asset delivery are not implemented.

Two coastal remainder pieces extend beyond the unchanged 10 km original-contact bound. Some inner land remains due to conservative 1 km contact sampling and an inscribed 32-sided distance boundary. Residual-strip-free coverage is not claimed.

The default PRK→CHN first captured county has only neighboring Chinese counties larger than the unchanged 2800 km² cap. The verified same-front chain uses the supported north direction. No arbitrary county splitting or cap relaxation was used.
